description: Check a UUID (GUID) against RFC 9562: whether it is a well-formed UUID, the text form it was sent in (hyphens, braces, urn:uuid:, upper case), its standard lowercase form, the variant, the version (1 to 8) and what that version means, and for the time-based versions the time inside it: v1 and v6 to 100 nanoseconds (UTC, counted from 15 Oct 1582), v7 to the millisecond (Unix time). Also the nil and max UUIDs, the clock sequence and whether the v1 or v6 node looks like a hardware MAC address or a random value. Useful to see when a v1, v6 or v7 ID was made, or why a system refuses an ID. Answer fields: ok, verdict, result, rule, does_not, sources, observation, signature, verify. Errors: ok false with the reason (bad input, too large, hourly limit). Free. No model, no network, nothing you send is stored by the tool, and every answer is signed with LLPRO's key (check it at https://llpro.ai/uuid-check). Not legal, tax or financial advice.

uuid.description: The UUID, such as 017f22e2-79b0-7cc3-98c4-dc0c0c07398f, {017F22E2-79B0-7CC3-98C4-DC0C0C07398F}, urn:uuid:017f22e2-79b0-7cc3-98c4-dc0c0c07398f, or 32 hex digits without hyphens.
